name: Jonathan Demme
bio: Robert Jonathan Demme was an American director, producer, and screenwriter.

name: Judd Apatow
bio: Judd Apatow is an American producer, writer, director, actor and stand-up comedian.

name: Christopher Nolan
bio: British-American director known for cerebral blockbusters like Inception and Interstellar.

name: Greta Gerwig
bio: American actress and director acclaimed for Lady Bird and Barbie.

name: Quentin Tarantino
bio: Quentin Tarantino is an acclaimed American filmmaker known for his stylized violence, sharp dialogue, and nonlinear storytelling.

name: Steven Spielberg
bio: Legendary director of Jaws, E.T., and Schindler’s List.

name: Ava DuVernay
bio: Award-winning filmmaker known for Selma and 13th, focusing on social justice themes.

name: Bong Joon-ho
bio: South Korean director of Parasite, known for blending genres and satire.

name: Sofia Coppola
bio: American director recognized for Lost in Translation and The Virgin Suicides.

name: Jordan Peele
bio: Comedian turned filmmaker known for Get Out and other horror-thrillers with social commentary.
